Question Title: Maintain Detailed Asset Inventory
Question Description: Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all technology assets with the potential to store or process information. This inventory shall include all hardware assets, whether connected to the organization's network or not.

Question Title:
Address Unauthorized
Assets
Question Description:
Ensure that unauthorized assets are either
removed from the network, quarantined or
the inventory is updated in a timely manner.

Question Title:
Maintain Inventory of
Authorized Software
Question Description: Maintain an up-to-date list of all authorized software that is required in the enterprise for any business purpose on any business system.

Question Title:
Ensure Software is
Supported by Vendor
Question Description: Ensure that only software applications or operating systems currently supported and receiving vendor updates are added to the organization's authorized software inventory. Unsupported software should be tagged as unsupported in the inventory system.

Question Title:
Address Unapproved
Software
Question Description: Ensure that unauthorized software is either removed or the inventory is updated in a timely manner.

Question Title: Deploy Automated Operating System Patch Management Tools
Question Description: Deploy automated software update tools in order to ensure that the operating systems are running the most recent security updates provided by the software vendor.

Question Title: Deploy Automated Software Patch Management Tools
Question Description: Deploy automated software update tools in order to ensure that third-party software on all systems is running the most recent security updates provided by the software vendor.

Question Title:
Change Default
Passwords
Question Description: Before deploying any new asset, change all default passwords to have values consistent with administrative level accounts.

Question Title:
Ensure the Use of Dedicated
Administrative Accounts
Question Description: Ensure that all users with administrative account access use a dedicated or secondary account for elevated activities. This account should only be used for administrative activities and not internet browsing, email, or similar activities.

Question Title:
Establish Secure
Configurations
Question Description: Maintain documented security configuration standards for all authorized operating systems and software.

Question Title:
Activate Audit
Logging
Question Description: Ensure that local logging has been enabled on all systems and networking devices.

Question Title:
Ensure Use of Only
Fully Supported
Browsers and Email
Clients
Question Description: Ensure that only fully supported web browsers and email clients are allowed to execute in the organization, ideally only using the latest version of the browsers and email clients provided by the vendor.

Question Title:
Use of DNS Filtering
Services
Question Description: Use Domain Name System (DNS) filtering services to help block access to known malicious domains.

Question Title:
Ensure Anti-Malware
Software and Signatures
are Updated
Question Description:
Ensure that the organization’s anti-malware
software updates its scanning engine and
signature database on a regular basis.

Question Title:
Configure Anti-Malware
Scanning of Removable
Devices
Question Description:
Configure devices so that they automatically
conduct an anti-malware scan of removable
media when inserted or connected.

Question Title:
Configure Devices to
Not Auto-Run Content
Question Description:
Configure devices to not auto-run content from
removable media.

Question Title:
Apply Host-Based
Firewalls or Port Filtering
Question Description:
Apply host-based firewalls or port filtering tools
on end systems, with a default-deny rule that
drops all traffic except those services and ports
that are explicitly allowed.

Question Title:
Ensure Regular
Automated Backups
Question Description:
Ensure that all system data is automatically
backed up on a regular basis.

Question Title:
Perform Complete
System Backups
Question Description:
Ensure that all of the organization’s key systems
are backed up as a complete system, through
processes such as imaging, to enable the quick
recovery of an entire system.

Question Title: Protect Backups
Question Description:
Ensure that backups are properly protected via
physical security or encryption when they are
stored, as well as when they are moved across the
network. This includes remote backups and cloud
services.

Question Title:
Ensure All Backups Have
at Least One Offline
Backup Destination
Question Description: Ensure that all backups have at least one offline (i.e., not accessible via a network connection) backup destination.

Question Title:
Install the Latest Stable
Version of Any Security-Related
Updates on All
Network Devices
Question Description:
Install the latest stable version of any security-related
updates on all network devices.

Question Title:
Maintain an Inventory of
Network Boundaries
Question Description:
Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all of the
organization’s network boundaries.

Question Title:
Deny Communication
over Unauthorized Ports
Question Description:
Deny communication over unauthorized TCP or
UDP ports or application traffic to ensure that
only authorized protocols are allowed to cross
the network boundary in or out of the network at
each of the organization’s network boundaries.

Question Title:
Maintain an Inventory of
Sensitive Information
Question Description: Maintain an inventory of all sensitive information stored, processed, or transmitted by the organization's technology systems, including those located onsite or at a remote service provider.

Question Title:
Remove Sensitive
Data or Systems Not
Regularly Accessed by
Organization
Question Description: Remove sensitive data or systems not regularly accessed by the organization from the network. These systems shall only be used as stand alone systems (disconnected from the network) by the business unit needing to occasionally use the system or completely virtualized and powered off until needed.

Question Title: Encrypt Mobile Device Data
Question Description: Utilize approved cryptographic mechanisms to protect enterprise data stored on all mobile devices.

Question Title:
Protect Information
through Access Control
Lists
Question Description:
Protect all information stored on systems with
file system, network share, claims, application,
or database specific access control lists. These
controls will enforce the principle that only
authorized individuals should have access to the
information based on their need to access the
information as a part of their responsibilities

Question Title:
Leverage the Advanced
Encryption Standard (AES) to
Encrypt Wireless Data
Question Description:
Leverage the Advanced Encryption Standard
(AES) to encrypt wireless data in transit.

Question Title:
Create Separate Wireless
Network for Personal and
Untrusted Devices
Question Description:
Create a separate wireless network for personal
or untrusted devices. Enterprise access from this
network should be treated as untrusted and
filtered and audited accordingly

Question Title:
Disable Any Unassociated
Accounts
Question Description:
Disable any account that cannot be associated with a
business process or business owner.

Question Title: Disable Dormant Accounts
Question Description:
Automatically disable dormant accounts after a set
period of inactivity.

Question Title:
Lock Workstation Sessions
After Inactivity
Question Description:
Automatically lock workstation sessions after a standard
period of inactivity.

Question Title:
Implement a Security
Awareness Program
Question Description:
Create a security awareness program for all
workforce members to complete on a regular
basis to ensure they understand and exhibit
the necessary behaviors and skills to help
ensure the security of the organization. The
organization’s security awareness program should
be communicated in a continuous and engaging
manner.

Question Title:
Train Workforce on
Secure Authentication
Question Description:
Train workforce members on the importance of
enabling and utilizing secure authentication.

Question Title:
Train Workforce on
Identifying Social
Engineering Attacks
Question Description:
Train the workforce on how to identify different
forms of social engineering attacks, such as
phishing, phone scams and impersonation calls.

Question Title:
Train Workforce on
Sensitive Data Handling
Question Description: Train workforce members on how to identify and properly store, transfer, archive and destroy sensitive information.

Question Title:
Train Workforce on
Causes of Unintentional
Data Exposure
Question Description:
Train workforce members to be aware of causes
for unintentional data exposures, such as losing
their mobile devices or emailing the wrong person
due to autocomplete in email.

Question Title:
Train Workforce Members
on Identifying and
Reporting Incidents
Question Description: Train workforce members to be able to identify the most common indicators of an incident and be able to report such an incident.

Question Title:
Document Incident
Response Procedures
Question Description:
Ensure that there are written incident response
plans that define roles of personnel as well as
phases of incident handling/management.

Question Title:
Designate Management
Personnel to Support
Incident Handling
Question Description:
Designate management personnel, as well as
backups, who will support the incident handling
process by acting in key decision-making roles.

Question Title:
Maintain Contact
Information For
Reporting Security
Incidents
Question Description:
Assemble and maintain information on third-party
contact information to be used to report
a security incident, such as Law Enforcement,
relevant government departments, vendors, and
Information Sharing and Analysis Center (ISAC) partners.

Question Title:
Publish Information
Regarding Reporting
Computer Anomalies and
Incidents
Question Description:
Publish information for all workforce members,
regarding reporting computer anomalies and
incidents, to the incident handling team. Such
information should be included in routine
employee awareness activities.
